stated: The Conservative Party will continue to develop a UK-wide Deposit Return Scheme, while working to minimise its impact on businesses and consumers.

source.quote: We will continue to develop a UK-wide Deposit Return Scheme, while working to minimise the impact on businesses and consumers.

bearing_set.reason: A Deposit Return Scheme directly targets plastic/glass/can litter and recycling rates, materially affecting waste pollution and environmental quality.

membership_note: The policy's primary and non-negligible effect is environmental (O6). Consumer deposit costs are designed to be fully refundable on return, making the net cost-of-living effect (O2) negligible for participating households. Business compliance costs are real but modest at macro scale and insufficient to earn a non-negligible verdict on O13 or O12 without a mechanism that materially moves those indicators. No other fundamentals are plausibly affected at a non-negligible level.
